correctness.rationale: Write u=ax+by+cx²+dxy+ey²+fx²y+gxy²+hx²y² and stratify lowest degree. If ab!=0, dim A/(u)=3 and u^4=6a²b² x²y²!=0; degree rank lower bound of L_(u²)>=4 forces (5,3,1). If exactly one linear coefficient nonzero, opposite-square coefficient selects (4,3,2) vs a unit multiple of x or y (3,3,3). For nonzero quadratic Q, rank L_u=2+rank[[d,c],[e,d]], and rank L_(u²)=1_{d²+2ce!=0}. The projective conics d²−ce=0 and d²+2ce=0 are split with q+1 rational points each, intersect at 2(q−1) nonzero affine triples in characteristic>=5; their four strata give exact counts q³ times each conic intersection class. Cubic-only rank2 and quartic-only rank1 complete all cases; counts sum q^8. Independent multiplication-matrix ranks and conic counts checked over F5,F7,F11; finite tests do not extend field quantifier.
